items.text: Food insecurity continues to be a serious issue for NH families. Hunger advocates are working hard to help eligible NH residents enroll - the State must bolster outreach efforts to enroll eligible Granite Staters in federal nutrition programs.
NH residents can learn more about SNAP eligibility here: https://t.co/z6cVCc7LhC

For too many NH students, school meals are the most reliable source of nutrition they receive all day. Unfortunately, NH lags behind in school breakfast participation. The State must prioritize efforts to boost participation to help eligible students access this critical program.

Proud that the @NHNationalGuard 157th Air Refueling Wing's KC-46s will participate in Air Defender 23, a major NATO exercise that will showcase the unity of the transatlantic Alliance & the critical role the Granite State plays in our national defense. https://t.co/v1dsqzJOzx

Proud that @NHNationalGuard’s @157ARW will play an important role in the largest NATO air exercise ever carried out over Europe. Granite State airmen and airwomen continue to have an important mission for our national security both at home and abroad. 
https://t.co/bG1nDCQoZH

It’s been three years since we lost Congressman John Lewis, one of our nation’s greatest civil rights heroes. As we honor his legacy, it’s important that we continue his work to ensure that all Americans can exercise their fundamental right to vote. https://t.co/2DOcb3f7nu

Granite Staters: As Canadian wildfire smoke continues to spread, an air quality alert is in effect in NH. Per guidance from @NHDES, at-risk individuals should exercise caution and limit any strenuous or prolonged time outdoors.

https://t.co/lHaPN5JgSg

I was happy to be in Portsmouth to see first-hand the great work happening at Gather to combat hunger on the Seacoast. As Congress works to reauthorize the Farm Bill, I will continue to fight for federal nutrition programs and resources to address food insecurity. https://t.co/bIVeU5Ioo3

For Americans living with diabetes, access to insulin is a life-or-death issue. I’ve long pushed to lower insulin costs so patients are no longer forced to ration their doses or forgo treatment altogether.

Patients have waited long enough – it’s time the Congress acts to bring down sky-high prices and save lives.

A Republican–driven shutdown would cut support for participants in @USDA’s WIC food assistance program, which provides critical nutrition for so many families.

Republicans' partisan agenda is putting children and families at risk, and it must stop.
During #NationalBreastCancerAwarenessMonth, it’s crucial we continue working to raise awareness, remove barriers to treatment and bolster efforts in search of a cure.

Today is Election Day, Granite Staters! If you’re an eligible voter, go exercise your civic duty and vote. There are many important local races this year so don’t miss out on the chance to make your voice heard. Confirm your polling location here:

https://t.co/jGCBfhue1M

No family in New Hampshire should live in fear that tomorrow they won’t have a roof over their head or a safe place to sleep.

I’m proud to help announce more than $12 million in federal funding to local organizations to provide shelter and services for Granite Staters in need.

Today, we remember the internment of more than 120,000 Japanese Americans during World War II.

As we honor those affected by this dark moment in American history, we must ensure this unjust treatment is never repeated.

During National Nutrition Month – let's recommit to ensuring every family has access to healthy food.

That's why I recently urged @USDA to work with New Hampshire to make sure eligible families can access Summer EBT benefits while their kids are home from school this summer.

With food insecurity impacting many Granite Staters, programs that put food on the table like the Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children, SNAP and Summer Electronic Benefit Transfer must be fully funded and accessible to eligible families.

Amid recent troubling allegations, the US must renew efforts to identify the cause behind directed energy attacks.  
  
@SenatorCollins and I are calling on @POTUS to investigate these allegations, review new evidence and ensure victims are compensated and can access treatment.

A powerful story demonstrating the mental and physical toll on our fishermen—including substance use disorder.

The bipartisan Fishing Industry Safety, Health, and Wellness Improvement Act—that I cosponsor— would improve federal support for the safety and well-being of fishermen.

A difficult but important decision from DoD to postpone the upcoming military exercise in Georgia. This delay reflects language I secured in the committee-passed NDAA, which requires review of the defense cooperation with Georgia following its passage of their foreign agents law.

Good news: @CMSGov is incorporating parts of my bipartisan legislation with @SenCapito into a new rule that will expand access to mental health treatment devices – a crucial step towards combatting the ongoing mental health and substance use epidemics. https://t.co/lgnYdnAnu8

ICYMI: My bipartisan NOPAIN Act is now being implemented and will help save lives by increasing access to non-opioid treatment options. This is a critical and long overdue step in mitigating the opioid crisis that has hurt too many families and communities.

Glad to see $10.6 million in federal funding that I helped secure come to rural communities across New Hampshire. From wastewater treatment upgrades in Newport, to solar installations in Lee, these funds will help decrease costs and improve communities.

https://t.co/yMswQBWLdL

Communities across NH have experienced heartbreak and loss from the substance use disorder epidemic.

This National Recovery Month and beyond, I’ll continue my work to expand access to prevention, treatment and recovery so that we can save lives and turn the tide on this crisis.

Food insecurity is a crisis across our country, including in New Hampshire.

During Hunger Action Month, I'm committed to continuing to fight for federal nutrition programs and resources to ensure Granite Staters don’t go hungry.

Breast cancer is one of the most common types of cancer for women, impacting loved ones, friends and community members.

During #NationalBreastCancerAwarenessMonth, we must continue to raise awareness, remove barriers to detection and treatment and further efforts to find a cure.
